meta.subject: What actors are actually paid in Mexico (Mexico City), 2018-2026, to replace the game's scaling of American union minimums
meta.method: WebSearch and WebFetch of press, ANDA's own site, Teatro UNAM, and the public repository of the Centro Federal de Conciliacion y Registro Laboral (CFCRL). Downloaded and parsed CCT salary-revision filings directly.
meta.headline_finding: ANDA's tabuladores are not all confidential. The CFCRL's public repository (repositorio.centrolaboral.gob.mx) holds salary-revision agreements that ANDA deposited, and some include the tabulador itself. Argos Television's 2025 filing includes 'sueldos_excel' spreadsheets containing ANDA's 'TABULADOR MINIMO PARA TELEVISION O PLATAFORMA DIGITAL', with every role tier and every programme length, plus the signed, stamped PDF of the same tables. Argos produces for streaming platforms as well as broadcast. This is the first real, citable ANDA minimum for TV/streaming. Dubbing (Diseno en Audio, Labodubb) and Televisa Producciones CCTs are also on file with the CFCRL, but the filings I could reach for them contain only voting records and no tables.
meta.confirmed_rule: confirmed: true only where the figure was read on the cited page or document itself (for the CFCRL files: in the downloaded spreadsheet or PDF).
caveats: The ANDA TV/platform tabulador is per programme (or chapter), banded by the programme's running time (15 to 180 min). That reading comes from the sheet's own wording, 'POR CADA PROGRAMA O CAPITULO ... LAS SIGUIENTES CANTIDADES'. It is a contractual MINIMUM ('tabulador minimo'). Producers pay a separately negotiated 'pago por produccion' on top, per ANDA's own Nomina Virtual page and Lizy Martinez's account.
The tabulador is per employer. Argos Television's is the only one I read. ANDA says TV tabuladores are 'creados por produccion' (built per production).
There is no 'SEGUNDAS PARTES' row in the Argos tabulador. Tiers are ESTELARES, COESTELARES, PRIMERAS PARTES and TERCERAS PARTES (the last marked 'SOLO COMISIONADO SINDICAL').
Fetch budget (~40) was exceeded slightly (~50) because the CFCRL find was worth following.

summary: Most important: ANDA's tabuladores are not wholly confidential. Collective-contract salary revisions deposited with the CFCRL are public, and Argos Television's 2025 filing includes ANDA's full 'Tabulador minimo para television o plataforma digital' as a spreadsheet and as a signed PDF. Its per-programme minimums, for 60-minute programmes in 2025: estelar MXN 2,927, coestelar 2,907, primera parte 1,959, tercera parte 1,370, plus 3% + 3% bonuses and a vacation/aguinaldo add-on. Increases were 3.8% for 2025 and 3.69% for 2026 (SPG Studios). ANDA's own site publishes the theater payroll floor (MXN 600 per day, 450 net). Teatro UNAM pays its touring cast MXN 12,000 a month and INBAL's CNT pays MXN 25,000-40,000 a month. Press gives the Televisa day rate (MXN 1,500-2,500 per llamado, ANDA portion, 2022-2023; about 2,800 for an aspirante in 2026, with overtime about 600/hour) and per-episode figures (lead MXN 10,000-18,000; extras 500-600 per episode). Dubbing has only a social-media figure (MXN 224 per llamado of up to 6 loops, 2023), though ANDA CCTs with Diseno en Audio and Labodubb sit in the same repository and their salary-revision filings may carry the dubbing tabulador. No sourced figures were found for film day rates, commercials, or Mexico City extras per day.

cfcrl_tables.producer: Televisa Producciones, S.A. de C.V. (CCT CC-156-1994-II)
cfcrl_tables.year: 2024-03-01 onward (revision of 2024; +4.7% on salaries in force to 2024-02-29)
cfcrl_tables.kind: television: telenovelas, series, unitarios, programs ('TABULADORES MINIMOS PARA TELEVISION PARA PROGRAMAS QUE SE TRANSMITEN LAS 24 HRS')
tiers: TERCERAS PARTE (modelos, duetos, trios, coros; por persona)
cfcrl_tables.unit: MXN per programme or chapter, banded by the programme's broadcast length (15/30/60/90/120/150/180 min). The convenio calls them 'salarios por cuota diaria'. Under the CCT (clauses C.3-C.4), a 4-hour telenovela day is paid as one half-hour chapter and a 7:30 day as two half-hour chapters, so a full telenovela day = 2 x the 30-min figure.
cfcrl_tables.bonuses: Separate 3% sheets on the same bands: 'APORTACION DEL 3% PARA FOMENTO DE ACTIVIDADES CULTURALES' (clausula 4a transitoria; e.g. estelar 60 min 81.45) and 'APORTACION DEL 3% PARA FOMENTO A LA EFICIENCIA' (same amounts); neither applies to overtime. CCT: overtime 'su pago sera al doble' (C.2); work on a statutory rest day pays a normal plus a double salary (C.11); minimum 10:30 h between llamados for the same programme, with any shortfall paid as overtime (cl. 22a-23a); llamados notified 24 h ahead; no actor is paid less than the quarter-hour rate even in shorter programmes (C.12). Effective workdays: 7:30 for a one-hour programme, 5:30 for a half-hour programme, 4:00 for a half-hour telenovela chapter (C.1).
cfcrl_tables.note: Read from the 'sueldos_excel' attachment (10 sheets, dated 'Ciudad de Mexico a 1ro. Marzo del 2024', signed for Televisa by Vladimir Martin Rivas Fonseca and Hugo Humberto Rios Martinez and for ANDA by Marco Antonio Trevino Mieres). The 4.7% figure and the 'cuota diaria' wording are from the convenio PDF, clauses SEGUNDA and SEXTA. Strike file 375/2024, settled 2024-02-26 by an Acta de Sancion de Convenio (95 workers). The clause text (C.1-C.12, 22a-23a) is from the full CCT scanned in the 2023 revision filing: https://repositorio.centrolaboral.gob.mx/contrato/4301 (sustento_registro_contrato, 2023-03-01 to 2024-02-29). A sheet labelled 'hoja 10' repeats the efficiency-bonus sheet with 3x the amounts (e.g. 244.14 at 60 min); it appears to be for non-Spanish programmes (it matches hoja 9).

Signed for Azteca by Claudia Maria Teja Maceira and Maricarmen Munguia Ramirez. No 150-minute column. The later Azteca records (699144, 611203) have no tables attached.

summary_cfcrl: Pages 1-6 of ANDA's CFCRL listing (120 records) were surveyed. Tables were attached in only two new places, Televisa Producciones (2024) and Producciones Azteca Digital/TV Azteca (2023-24), plus Argos (2025), which was already found. In all three the unit is pay per programme or chapter, banded by running time. For Televisa a 7:30 telenovela day pays two half-hour chapters. So the Televisa supporting-actor minimum day is: primera parte 2,514, segunda 2,186, tercera 1,808, estelar 3,258 (MXN, March 2024), plus 3% + 3% bonuses. Overtime is paid at double. No dubbing tabulador is attached for any studio, so per-loop and per-llamado dubbing rates remain unconfirmed.
